optimizer: SGD, no momentum or weight decay

criteria.correct: positive gradients and updates each step; loss decreases each step
criteria.omit_backward: no gradients and no updates; loss unchanged
criteria.omit_step: positive gradients but no updates; loss unchanged

diagnosis: observation only; does not identify injected fault name
oracle: independent scalar analytical mean squared error and SGD, atol=rtol=1e-12
limits: single deterministic convex fixture; no classifier accuracy, general cause identification, convergence rate or throughput claim
